name: SEOChat Analyzer
author: seochatapp

sections.description:
SEOChat Analyzer brings professional SEO analysis directly into your WordPress post editor. Analyze on-page SEO, backlink profiles, and page speed without leaving the editor.

Features:

  • On-Page Analysis – Title tag, meta description, heading structure, internal/external links, and image count
  • Off-Page Analysis – Backlink summary, referring domains, dofollow/nofollow ratio
  • Speed Analysis – Lighthouse scores for Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO with Core Web Vitals
  • AI Content Intelligence – AI-powered content audit, readability analysis, and smart rewriter
  • AI Meta Generation – Generate optimized meta titles and descriptions with AI
  • Competitor Intelligence – Compare your backlink profile against any competitor URL
  • Smart Caching – Results cached for 24 hours using WordPress Transient API
  • Credit System – Track remaining credits with upgrade prompts

SEOChat Analyzer uses the SEOChat API to provide advanced SEO analysis features inside WordPress. New users can create a free SEOChat account and receive free credits to get started, with no credit card required.

External Services

This plugin connects to the SEOChat API (https://seochat.app) to perform SEO analysis.

What data is sent:
When you trigger an analysis, the URL of the post or page being analyzed is transmitted to SEOChat servers for processing. No personally identifiable information about your site visitors is collected or transmitted.

When data is sent:
Data is only sent when you explicitly click an analysis button inside the WordPress editor. No data is sent automatically or in the background.

Third-party service terms:
* Terms of Service: https://seochat.app/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://seochat.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seochat-analyzer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > SEOChat Analyzer
  4. Enter your SEOChat API URL and API Key
  5. Open any post or page in the editor to see the SEOChat Analyzer meta box

Getting your API Key:

  1. Sign in to your SEOChat account at https://seochat.app
  2. Navigate to your account settings
  3. Generate an API key
  4. Copy the key and paste it in the plugin settings
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

You can create a free SEOChat account at https://seochat.app and generate an API key from your dashboard. Free credits are included to get started, and no credit card is required.

How many credits does each analysis cost?

  • On-Page Analysis: 4 credits
  • Off-Page Analysis: 3 credits
  • Speed Analysis: 3 credits
  • AI Meta Generation: 4 credits

How long are results cached?

Results are cached locally for 24 hours. Use the refresh button to bypass the cache.

Does this plugin work with Gutenberg?

The plugin adds a meta box that works with both the Classic Editor and Gutenberg.

Does this plugin send data to external services?

Yes. When you run an analysis, the URL of the page being analyzed is sent to the SEOChat API (https://seochat.app) for processing. No personal data about your site visitors is transmitted. See the “External Services” section for full details.

Is the plugin free?

The plugin itself is free and open source (GPL v2). SEO analysis features require a SEOChat account. A free tier is available at https://seochat.app.
